title: A reactivated tier's columns come back with their rules
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix A, in which tier A has its own rule 15% off.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Tiers tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Open tier A's three-dot menu.
  3. Click Archive.
  4. Click Archive in the dialog.
  5. Open tier A's three-dot menu again.
  6. Click Reactivate.
  7. Click the Matrices tab on Settings › Pricing.
  8. Click matrix A's name on the Matrices list.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Tier A is listed.

Step 2:

  • The menu offers Archive.

Step 3:

  • The Archive question opens.

Step 4:

  • Tier A is archived.

Step 5:

  • The menu offers Reactivate.

Step 6:

  • Tier A is active again, last.

Step 7:

  • Matrix A is listed.

Step 8:

  • Matrix A's grid has tier A's column again.
  • It reads 15% off in every range.
